name: Special Planning Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
CHAIRPERSON MANALO

  VICE CHAIR DIAZ | COMMISSIONER FONSECA

  COMMISSIONER BARCELOS | COMMISSIONER PALHINHA

  CITY OF ARTESIA
  REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING

  Monday, March 25, 2024 | 7:00 p.m.

  PRIMARY LOCATION

  City Council Chambers of Artesia City Hall
  18747 Clarkdale Avenue
  (562) 865-6262

  AGENDA ITEMS
1.  Call to Order

2.  Invocation

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

4.  Roll Call of Commission

5.  Approval of Agenda

6.  Announcement of Speaker Slips

  For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item
  on the agenda, please complete a Speaker Slip located in the lobby or at the
  podium and deposit it with the Community Development Director prior to the
  commencement of the meeting. Under California law, public comments at special
  meetings are limited to subjects on the agenda, only. Please note that there is a
  five-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this time limit.

7.  Public Comments for Items Not on the Agenda

8.  New Business – Non-Public Hearing (None)

9.  New Business – Public Hearing

  A.  Case No. 2024-08: A REQUEST FOR 1) A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
  TO ALLOW AN EXISTING INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY TO ESTABLISH THE
  BUSINESS USE OF AN AUTOMOBILE PAINTING WITH SPRAY

  1
   BOOTH(S) SERVICE WITHIN THE M-1 (MANUFACTURING AND
  INDUSTRIAL) ZONE AND 2) A DESIGN REVIEW FOR THE
  CONSTRUCTION OF THE NEW 30 FT BY 35 FT (1,050 SQUARE FEET)
  DETACHED STRUCTURE TO ENCLOSE THE SPRAY BOOTH(S)
  LOCATED AT 18715 CORBY AVENUE IN THE MANUFACTURING AND
  INDUSTRIAL (M-1) ZONE
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  B.  Case No. 2024-09: THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL CONSIDER
  AND PROVIDE A RECOMMENDATION TO THE CITY COUNCIL FOR
  TWO SEPARATE ORDINANCES: 1) ORDINANCE 24-952, A ZONING
  ORDINANCE AMENDMENT TO IDENTIFY AN AUTOMATED CAR WASH
  FACILITY AS A CONDITIONALLY PERMITTED USE WITHIN THE C-G
  (COMMERCIAL GENERAL) ZONE. 2) ORDINANCE 24-947 A
  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF ARTESIA AND
  DONG AH DEVELOPMENT USA, INC. FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED
  AT 11701 SOUTH STREET AND MAKING A DETERMINATION OF
  EXEMPTION UNDER THE CEQA GUIDELINES.
  Case 2024-09
  PC Resolution No. 2024-04P
  PC Resolution No. 2024-05P
  Proposed Ordinance No. 24-952
  Proposed Ordinance No. 24-947
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

10.  Discussion/Report Items from Staff (None)

11.  Items from the Commission

12.  Adjournment to the Regular Planning Commission Meeting to be held on
  Tuesday, April 16, 2024, at 7:00 p.m., in the City Council Chambers of Artesia
  City Hall at 18747 Clarkdale Avenue, Artesia.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please contact
the Planning Department at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
